{"id":1933961802,"question_id":4219,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1772300912,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1933961802/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Operations to Make Array Parity Alternating","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> makeParityAlternating(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<int>ans(2);\n\n        int mismatched = 0;\n        int maxval = *max_element(nums.begin() , nums.end());\n        int minval = *min_element(nums.begin() , nums.end());\n        int oprs = 0;\n\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            if((abs(nums[i]) % 2 == 1 and abs(nums[i-1]) % 2 == 0) or (abs(nums[i]) % 2 == 0 and abs(nums[i-1]) % 2 == 1)) continue;\n            else mismatched++;\n\n            if(mismatched > 0)\n            {\n                if(abs(nums[i] - maxval) < abs(nums[i] - minval))\n                {\n                    nums[i]--;\n                }\n                else nums[i]++;\n\n                mismatched = 0;\n                oprs++;\n            }\n        }\n\n        int new_maxval = *max_element(nums.begin() , nums.end());\n        int new_minval = *min_element(nums.begin() , nums.end());\n        ans[0] = oprs;\n        ans[1] = new_maxval - new_minval;\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-operations-to-make-array-parity-alternating","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1752}
